name: TowerPro MG996R servo
description: Metal-gear standard servo, used for steering. Powered from the ESC's 6 V BEC.

pins.name: SIGNAL
pins.description: 50 Hz pulses; 3.3 V logic is enough.

notes: Published: 4.8-6.6 V; 0.15 s/60 deg at 6.0 V (= 400 deg/s); stall torque 11 kg.cm at 6.0 V (1.08 N.m); dead band 1 us; idle 10 mA, no-load running 170 mA (typical), stall 1400 mA (peak); 55 g; 40.7 x 19.7 x 42.9 mm; travel 0-159 deg (TowerPro answer on the product page). Not published: the pulse range. 500-2500 us for the full 159 deg is an estimate; firmware sending 1000-2000 us gets about +-40 deg.
